items_flat.title_en: Google launches Gemini 4 Argon, first only to trusted cyber defenders
items_flat.title_zh: Google 推出 Gemini 4 Argon，先只給受信任資安防衛者
items_flat.summary_en: Google DeepMind announced Gemini 4 Argon, a new frontier model for long-horizon coding, enterprise knowledge work, and cybersecurity defense. It is rolling out first through the Fairwind Program to trusted cyber defenders while Google takes a phased path toward paid API and Google AI Ultra. The company lists an industry-leading 1M output-token limit, introductory API pricing of $2/$10 per million tokens ($4/$20 after the intro period), and a DeepSWE v1.1 score of 77.9%.
items_flat.summary_zh: Google DeepMind 宣布新一代前沿模型 Gemini 4 Argon，鎖定長時程工程、企業知識工作與資安防禦。目前先經 Fairwind 計畫交給受信任防衛者，再分階段開放付費 API 與 Google AI Ultra。官方標榜輸出上限 100 萬 tokens、導入價每百萬 tokens $2/$10（之後 $4/$20），DeepSWE v1.1 為 77.9%。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is the first Google flagship named Gemini 4, and the gated cyber-first rollout is the product decision: capability is asserted, general availability is not. Benchmark leads are Google-selected and mixed—Argon does not sweep Terminal-Bench 4.0 or FrontierSWE v2—so the race remains close until independent evals and a public API appear.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是 Google 首款以 Gemini 4 命名的旗艦，先給資安圈、暫不全面開放，才是產品決策。基準領先來自自家對照表且並非全勝，獨立評測與公開 API 出現前，與 Astra、Opus 5.5 的差距仍不確定。
items_flat.quote: Today, we’re announcing our new frontier model, Gemini 4 Argon, which is rolling out to a set of trusted cyber defenders through our Fairwind Program.
items_flat.quote_zh: 今天我們宣布新的前沿模型 Gemini 4 Argon，正透過 Fairwind 計畫釋出給一組受信任的資安防衛者。

items_flat.title_en: FTC opens consumer-harm probe of OpenAI, Anthropic and other labs
items_flat.title_zh: FTC 對 OpenAI、Anthropic 等實驗室展開消費者危害調查
items_flat.summary_en: Reuters, Bloomberg, the Washington Post and ABC News reported that the U.S. FTC has opened a broad inquiry into whether OpenAI, Anthropic and other AI firms violated unfair-or-deceptive-practices law. Officials said the agency plans formal information demands and to compel testimony from executives, including at METR. The labs had not issued a public response in the cited reports.
items_flat.summary_zh: 路透、彭博、華盛頓郵報與 ABC 報導，美國 FTC 已對 OpenAI、Anthropic 及其他 AI 公司是否違反不公平或欺瞞行為法展開廣泛調查。官員稱將發正式資料要求並傳喚高階主管作證，對象也包括 METR。相關報導中各實驗室尚未公開回應。
items_flat.analysis_en: Coming a day after a penalty-free White House pledge, this is the first named Trump-era enforcement track on agent incidents—but it is still an investigation, not a complaint or fine. Scope, timing of CIDs, and whether Google or xAI are formally included remain unconfirmed.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 緊接在白宮無罰則承諾隔日，這是川普任期首個點名代理人事故的執法軌道，但仍只是調查而非起訴或罰鍰。調查範圍、正式傳票時程，以及 Google、xAI 是否被正式列入，皆尚未證實。
items_flat.quote: The Federal Trade Commission is conducting an industry-wide probe into Anthropic, OpenAI and other AI labs to uncover the potential dangers their technology poses to consumers.
items_flat.quote_zh: 聯邦貿易委員會正對 Anthropic、OpenAI 及其他 AI 實驗室展開全產業調查，以釐清其技術對消費者的潛在危害。

items_flat.title_en: White House accord: labs pledge four-layer AI controls, no penalties named
items_flat.title_zh: 白宮協議：實驗室承諾四層控管，未列罰則
items_flat.summary_en: President Trump released a one-page White House Accord on Super Intelligence, also called the Joint Commitment on Frontier Responsibilities, signed with executives from Google (Sundar Pichai), Anthropic (Dario Amodei), Meta (Mark Zuckerberg), OpenAI (Greg Brockman), xAI (Elon Musk) and Nvidia (Jensen Huang). The text asks each frontier trainer to run internal controls, an empowered internal safety team, an independent external auditor, and a board committee. A separate executive order told agencies to prefer the term “Super Intelligence.”
items_flat.summary_zh: 川普公布一頁《超級智慧白宮協議／前沿責任共同承諾》，簽署者包括 Google 皮查伊、Anthropic 阿莫代、Meta 祖克柏、OpenAI 布羅克曼、xAI 馬斯克與輝達黃仁勳。內容要求前沿訓練者做內部控管、授權內部安全團隊、獨立外部稽核與董事會委員會。另有行政命令要求行政部門改稱「超級智慧」。
items_flat.analysis_en: This remains the first same-table written pledge covering the tracked U.S. frontier vendors after a week of agent-safety incidents. Product change is still undefined: who audits, what the standard is, and what happens on a miss are not named, and the FTC probe the next day shows the pledge does not freeze existing consumer law.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這仍是代理人安全事故週後、美國主要前沿廠商同桌簽署的首份書面承諾。產品層改變尚未定義：誰稽核、標準為何、違規後果皆未寫明；隔日 FTC 調查也顯示承諾並未凍結既有消費者法。
items_flat.quote: Therefore, in addition to any other precautions, we believe each company should implement the following four layers of controls and audits.
items_flat.quote_zh: 因此，除其他預防措施外，我們認為每家公司都應實施以下四層控管與稽核。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI says it disrupted a coordinated model-distillation campaign
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI 稱已打斷一場協調式模型蒸餾行動
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI published a security post saying it identified and disrupted a campaign, first seen in early July, that tried to extract protected model reasoning for adversarial distillation. It said operators did not break encryption or steal stored chats, but scaled terms-of-service-violating prompts; a core cluster was attributed to people associated with Moonshot AI (Kimi). OpenAI said it shared findings via the Frontier Model Forum.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI 發布資安文，稱自 7 月初起發現並打斷試圖擷取受保護推理、供對抗式蒸餾的行動。公司表示攻擊者並未破解加密或竊取既有對話，而是大規模違反服務條款的提示操作；核心叢集歸因於與月之暗面（Kimi）相關人士。OpenAI 稱已透過 Frontier Model Forum 分享發現。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is an official attribution post, not a court finding: Moonshot is named, but OpenAI also says it is unclear whether all operators were one actor. The operational change is tighter reasoning-protection and account enforcement; whether other labs saw the same pattern is not independently confirmed here.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是官方歸因聲明而非法院認定：點名月之暗面，同時承認未必全是單一行為者。實質變化是加強推理防護與帳號處置；其他實驗室是否遭遇同一手法，本文並無獨立佐證。
items_flat.quote: However, we attribute a core cluster of the activity to individuals associated with Moonshot AI, the developer of Kimi.
items_flat.quote_zh: 不過，我們將其中一個核心活動叢集歸因於與月之暗面（Kimi 開發商）相關的人士。

items_flat.title_en: Google rolls out Gemini Skills globally; Gems to be retired
items_flat.title_zh: Google 全球推出 Gemini Skills，Gems 將退役
items_flat.summary_en: Google said Skills—reusable slash-command instructions already in Gemini Spark—are rolling out in Gemini chat globally and will come to Workspace in the coming weeks. Skills will replace Gems; personal-account Gems support ends starting November, with Workspace business/enterprise/nonprofit in March 2027 and education in June 2027. Remaining Gems are to be auto-migrated to draft Skills; Opal will also shut down in November.
items_flat.summary_zh: Google 表示已在 Gemini Spark 的可重用斜線指令 Skills，正全球進入 Gemini 對話，並將於數週內進入 Workspace。Skills 將取代 Gems；個人帳號自 11 月起停用，Workspace 商務／企業／非營利為 2027 年 3 月、教育為 2027 年 6 月。剩餘 Gems 將自動遷成草稿 Skills；Opal 也將於 11 月關閉。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is a consumer-surface consolidation, not a frontier-model event. The uncertainty is operational: whether migrated Gems keep behavior and sharing, and whether Opal users get a replacement path beyond the stated auto-migrate.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是消費端介面整併，不是前沿模型事件。不確定點在營運：遷移後的 Gems 是否保留行為與分享，以及 Opal 用戶除自動遷移外有無替代路徑。
items_flat.quote: Today, we’re rolling out skills directly into Gemini chat globally, and bringing this functionality to Google Workspace business, enterprise, nonprofit, and education customers in the coming weeks.
items_flat.quote_zh: 今天我們把 Skills 直接推到全球 Gemini 對話，並將在未來數週帶給 Google Workspace 商務、企業、非營利與教育客戶。

items_flat.title_en: Anthropic sets Claude Sonnet 4.5 API retirement for November 30
items_flat.title_zh: Anthropic 訂 Claude Sonnet 4.5 API 於 11 月 30 日退役
items_flat.summary_en: Anthropic’s platform release notes for September 30 announced deprecation of Claude Sonnet 4.5 (`claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929`), with API retirement scheduled for November 30, 2026. The company recommended migrating to Claude Sonnet 5.5.
items_flat.summary_zh: Anthropic 9 月 30 日平台發行說明宣布淘汰 Claude Sonnet 4.5（`claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929`），API 預計 2026 年 11 月 30 日退役，並建議改用 Claude Sonnet 5.5。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is a catalog cleanup after last week’s Sonnet 5.5 launch, not a new capability. Teams still pinned to 4.5 have a two-month clock; behavior diffs versus 5.5 were already flagged in the 5.5 notes.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是上週 Sonnet 5.5 上市後的目錄清理，不是新能力。仍釘在 4.5 的團隊只剩約兩個月；與 5.5 的行為差異先前發行說明已提示。
items_flat.quote: We announced the deprecation of the Claude Sonnet 4.5 model (claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929), with retirement on the Claude API scheduled for November 30, 2026.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我們宣布淘汰 Claude Sonnet 4.5 模型（claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929），Claude API 預計於 2026 年 11 月 30 日退役。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI posts small-business agents report and ASBDC training partnership
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI 發布中小企業代理人報告並與 ASBDC 合作培訓
items_flat.summary_en: On X, OpenAI said a new report looks at how small businesses use AI agents for customers, products and finance, and that a partnership with the America’s SBDC network will add hands-on AI training and local guidance for owners.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI 在 X 表示，新報告檢視中小企業如何把 AI 代理人用在客戶、產品與財務，並與美國中小企業發展中心網絡合作，為業主提供實作培訓與在地指引。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is distribution and narrative after DevDay, not a new model. Impact depends on whether the training program actually reaches SBDC clients; that was not evidenced in the post.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是 DevDay 後的通路與敘事，不是新模型。影響取決於培訓是否真正送到 SBDC 客戶；該貼文並未提出證據。
items_flat.quote: Small teams are taking on more with AI—from finding customers to building products and managing finances.
items_flat.quote_zh: 小團隊正用 AI 承擔更多工作——從找客戶、做產品到管財務。

frontier_other.analysis_en: This remains the first same-table written pledge covering the tracked U.S. frontier vendors after a week of agent-safety incidents. Product change is still undefined: who audits, what the standard is, and what happens on a miss are not named, and the FTC probe the next day shows the pledge does not freeze existing consumer law.
frontier_other.analysis_zh: 這仍是代理人安全事故週後、美國主要前沿廠商同桌簽署的首份書面承諾。產品層改變尚未定義：誰稽核、標準為何、違規後果皆未寫明；隔日 FTC 調查也顯示承諾並未凍結既有消費者法。
frontier_other.quote: Therefore, in addition to any other precautions, we believe each company should implement the following four layers of controls and audits.
frontier_other.quote_zh: 因此，除其他預防措施外，我們認為每家公司都應實施以下四層控管與稽核。

brief_en: Google launched Gemini 4 Argon to Fairwind cyber defenders first, with 1M output tokens. The FTC opened a consumer-harm probe of OpenAI, Anthropic and others a day after a penalty-free White House frontier accord. OpenAI said it disrupted a Moonshot-linked distillation campaign and posted a small-business agents report. Gemini Skills begin replacing Gems.
brief_zh: Google 發表 Gemini 4 Argon，先給 Fairwind 資安防衛夥伴、輸出上限 100 萬 tokens。白宮無罰則承諾隔日，FTC 對 OpenAI、Anthropic 等展開消費者調查。OpenAI 稱已打斷疑似月之暗面相關蒸餾行動，並發布中小企業代理人報告。Gemini Skills 開始取代 Gems。
